_comment: Hand-curated voter identity rules, applied by scripts/build_voter_ballots.py.
Most cross-poll name variants were corrected in the workbook itself; this file
holds only the cases that CANNOT be fixed at source because both spellings are
aliases: variant name -> the name the voter should be listed under. Matching is
on the normalized form (case, accents and punctuation are already ignored), so
only genuine differences need an entry.
joint: a ballot submitted by more than one person. The ballot is listed on each
person's page, flagged as joint. Collectives that act as a single identity
(Ferronian Brigade, T A P E Collective) are deliberately NOT split - they are
distinct: pairs of similar names CONFIRMED to be different people. Nothing in
the build reads this - it is a record so a future name audit does not re-raise
them, because merging any of these would attribute one person's ballot to
another. Reviewed by hand against data/voter_name_review.csv.
